name: CYPRUS

flag.title: Flag of Cyprus
flag.note: White field, copper island, olive branches

lead: Cyprus is an island in the eastern Mediterranean Sea. Old stories say Aphrodite, goddess of love, rose from its waves. The word "copper" comes from its name.

facts.label: Capital
facts.sub: Only divided capital in the world

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Cyprus lies where Europe, Asia and Africa meet. The Troodos Mountains rise in the middle. Mount Olympus tops them at 1,952 m. People even ski there.
A flat plain called the Mesaoria lies between the mountains and the Kyrenia hills. Cyprus gets over 300 sunny days a year. It is one of Europe's sunniest places.
animals: The Cyprus mouflon is a wild sheep with big curly horns. It lives only in the Paphos forest. It was nearly wiped out, but now about 3,000 remain. It is the national animal.
The cat snake hunts at night. Its pupils are thin and upright, like a cat's. About 1 million street cats also live here. They outnumber people.
culture: Halloumi is a squeaky, salty cheese. You can grill it and it will not melt. The European Union (a group of European countries) now protects its name.
Every spring, Cyprus holds the Kataklysmos festival. People splash each other with water. Boat races, music and grilled halloumi fill the harbours.
history: People mined copper in Cyprus as early as 2500 BC. It was the ancient world's biggest supplier. The Latin word cuprum comes from the island's name, Kypros.

Aphrodite was said to be born at Petra tou Romiou, a sea rock. Romans, Byzantines (Eastern Romans), Crusaders (knights from Europe) and Ottomans (Turkish rulers) all ruled here. Cyprus became an independent republic in 1960.
wows: Only two flags show a map of their country: Cyprus and Kosovo.
Commandaria is the world's oldest named wine, made since at least 800 BC.
The world's oldest known pet burial is here: a cat beside its owner 9,500 years ago.
Dwarf elephants and pygmy hippos once lived on Cyprus.
Up to 20,000 flamingos winter at Larnaca Salt Lake, turning it pink from November to March.
People dug up the world's oldest perfumes here, 4,000 years old, scented with lavender and rosemary.
Nicosia is the last divided capital on Earth.

myths.myth: Cyprus is right next to Greece
myths.fact: Turkey is only about 70 km away. Athens is over 800 km away.
Flamingo chicks are born grey. They turn pink from the shrimp and algae they eat.
